nodes.evidence_snippet: two additional peaks at 888 and 1059 cm-1 were consistently found in the Raman spectra of NiMoCu. These peaks correspond to Ni-H* and Mo-OH* bonds, respectively... revealing that the incorporation of Cu induces the segregation of adsorption sites... in NiMo... no metal-H* bonds were observed... likely due to the stronger competitive adsorption of OH* over H*
